Autonomous AI agent for three way invoice matching: extracts supplier PDFs from email, matches with POs and receipts in Odoo ERP, auto-approves high confidence cases, and routes edge cases for human review. It automates supplier invoice ingestion, text OCR, semantic product matching, stock validation, Human-in-the-Loop manager approval, and transactional database updates via the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
